title: African Elephants Fell 77%
closing: Poaching slowed, but the surviving herds remain far smaller and still need protection.
question: Should ivory sales stay banned?

segments.say: African elephants fell 77 percent. More than three quarters disappeared despite their iconic status.
African elephants once numbered 1.3 million. The surviving population is now only a fraction of that.
African elephant poaching peaked at 10.1 percent yearly. Stronger ivory controls later cut the rate sharply.
